lessons_used: home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 4 wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), while 2 tests showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 3 wins (+11.3%, +7.2%, +3.7%), though 4 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.8%) and 1 test with no clear effect.
adoption, copy; sign_in, hint; and home, notification changes consistently showed no clear effect across all iterations.
sign_in, reorder and choose_path, redesign changes remain inconsistent, each generating 1 win and 1 significant loss.
Predictions consistently overestimate weak ideas and underestimate large wins, and evidence remains thin for kinds of change tested only once.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Mood and Interaction Onboarding Journey
candidates.change: Adds an interactive guided walkthrough on the final onboarding screen demonstrating how the pet reacts to mouse hovers, drags, and desktop idle states.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple tickets about confusion over controlling desktop pet interactions, and previous finish new_flow tests yielded high conversion wins (+11.3%, +7.2%).

home_intro.headline: Master Desktop Pet Controls & Interactions
home_intro.body: Try moving, hovering, and summoning your pet on your screen before launching to your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid redesign and interactive walkthrough on home_intro overlay within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has modest drop-off, but finish new_flow tests have strong historical win rates.

candidates.title: Pet Background Hatching Interactive Stage
candidates.change: Inserts a new pre-generation stage screen where users interact with a digital pet egg while waiting for asset generation.
candidates.why: The waiting stage has a long median (201s) and mean (2336s); introducing interactive waiting screens leverages strong positive trends from previous wait_info improvements.

new_hatching_stage.headline: Your Companion is Hatching!
new_hatching_stage.body: Tap or hover near the pet shell while our server builds your custom desktop companion graphics.

guard.reason: 'new_hatching_stage.components[1]': a timer may only count a real wait (the waiting screen)

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Animated Preparation Ticker
candidates.change: Displays an animated live updates feed on the waiting screen showing exactly how the pet is being prepared for desktop rendering.
candidates.why: Wait_info changes on the home waiting step consistently produced conversion wins (+4.1%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%).

waiting.headline: Preparing Desktop Animation Layers
waiting.body: We are calibrating screen boundaries, tray icon shortcuts, and desktop movement logic.

wait_status.text: Configuring multi-monitor placement and taskbar compatibility...

guard.reason: Valid update to waiting screen status information showing pet generation progress.

candidates.score_note: Home already converts at 94.8% limiting impact, but wait_info is a reliable winning strategy.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Taskbar Visibility Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Redesigns the finish screen into a spotlight layout emphasizing system tray access, pet hiding shortcuts, and desktop controls.
candidates.why: Three support tickets reported confusion on hiding/showing the pet and four reported desktop feature misbehavior post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Control pet visibility anytime from your system tray or quick key shortcuts.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a choice_cards cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Certificate Sign-In Sequence Shift
candidates.change: Moves sign-in screen after adoption certificate creation to contextually link account registration with saving pet certificate details.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again, and moving sign-in after pet customization anchors value before account creation.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Adoption Certificate to Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now so your customized desktop pet and certificate remain safely synced to your profile.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign-in step post-adoption as explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Strong support ticket evidence, though reordering screens shows volatile results.

candidates.title: Starter Companion Trait Badge Preview
candidates.change: Displays unlockable companion trait badges on the path selection screen to encourage path commitment.
candidates.why: The choose_path step sees an 82.5% pass rate with high drop-off time (514s mean duration).

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path & Unlock Unique Pet Badges
choose_path.body: Each path unlocks exclusive desktop behaviors and starter personality traits for your companion.

guard.reason: Choose path screen copy and components fail to offer both adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Two Column Stamp Review
candidates.change: Reorganizes the adoption certificate screen into a clear two-column layout highlighting pet details alongside final certificate confirmation.
candidates.why: Adoption stage experiences the biggest drop-off in the funnel (67.9% conversion); structural layout tweaks improve clarity without risky screen redesigns.

adoption_certificate.headline: Review and Seal Your Pet Adoption
adoption_certificate.body: Confirm your desktop pet name and traits before final generation begins.

guard.reason: Valid layout reorganization of adoption certificate screen retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 32.1% of users, but adoption layout and redesign tweaks historically underperform.

candidates.title: Pet Generation Activity Milestone Checklist
candidates.change: Replaces static waiting status text with an active visual milestone checklist showing rendering, behavior setup, and desktop integration progress.
candidates.why: Wait_info changes on home stage have strong track record (+4.1%, +3.1%), helping bridge long generation times (mean 2336s).

waiting.headline: Building Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: Track real-time generation milestones as your pet is finalized.

guard.reason: 'waiting.replace.wait_status[0]': a checklist cannot do the wait_status job (use ['animation', 'mascot', 'preview', 'progress', 'text', 'timer', 'tip_carousel'])

candidates.title: System Tray and Desktop Companion Dock Tutorial Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive step-by-step tutorial on home_intro showing how to dock, minimize, and restore the pet using system tray shortcuts.
candidates.why: Support received multiple tickets regarding pet visibility issues and desktop misbehavior; finish new_flow improvements have historically yielded huge wins (+11.3%, +7.2%).

home_intro.headline: System Tray & Desktop Controls Quick Guide
home_intro.body: Learn how to bring your pet to the front, minimize it while working, or open companion options.

guard.reason: Valid addition of tutorial flow on home_intro overlay.

candidates.score_note: Directly supported by complaints and aligned with high-performing finish new_flow interventions.

candidates.title: Permanent Pet Account Recovery Assurance Copy
candidates.change: Updates headline and body copy on sign_in screen to explicitly state that sign-in protects against pet loss and allows instant restore across devices.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets (largest theme) cited missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Pet & Prevent Data Loss
sign_in.body: Sign in to back up your desktop pet's growth, traits, and custom styling permanently to the cloud.

guard.reason: Valid copy update on sign-in screen emphasizing data protection and account restore.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing top support issue, though copy changes generally yield small lifts.
